findings.description: Multi-stage nested base64, shell variable concatenation, and hex escapes evade static regex and reach executor unexpectedly
Unwrapped raw OS subprocess calls (child_process.spawn) bypass in-process gate; requires OS-level containerization
Reported SHA-256 for dataset shard corresponds to Git commit SHA-1; true sample file SHA-256 is bd1c998ae...
Vault VSIX compiled locally with aligned publisher itsubsolomon, awaiting human release token for Open VSX publication

stop_conditions.trigger_reason: Prohibited destructive command reached downstream executor under obfuscation (C-03, C-04, C-05)
Pre-commit sentinel intercepted synthetic API key string in documentation

escalations.triggering_condition: Section 13.2 #1 (Unexpected execution on protected path) / Section 13.4
escalations.assigned_owner: Autonomous Security Validation Agent (Provisional Audit Lead)
escalations.required_decision: Formal review of demonstrated obfuscation bypasses (nested base64, shell variables, hex escapes) and authorization of remediation plan
escalations.resume_conditions: Implement iterative base64 decode and hex escape normalization; independently verify on a new run ID with zero downstream executor invocations; obtain explicit authorization from Security Decision Owner

escalations.triggering_condition: Section 13.2 #7 (Execution path outside in-process proxy boundary)
escalations.assigned_owner: Autonomous Security Validation Agent (Provisional Audit Lead)
escalations.required_decision: Acceptance of architectural boundary: in-process gate does not intercept unwrapped child_process.spawn; formal guidance requiring OS-level sandboxing (Docker/seccomp)
escalations.resume_conditions: Architectural limitation documented in deployment guidelines; no further in-process test required

escalations.triggering_condition: Section 13.5 (Evidence and Integrity Stop Rules - Artifact Identification)
escalations.assigned_owner: Autonomous Security Validation Agent (Provisional Evidence Custodian)
escalations.required_decision: Document that cad39281ed... is the Git commit SHA-1 of the HF repository and bd1c998ae... is the true SHA-256 of the 500-vector dataset shard sample
escalations.resume_conditions: Dual hash tracking established in release consistency and evidence manifests

escalations.required_decision: Human release authority to supply Open VSX API token and authorize publication of itsubsolomon.bartholomew-vault
escalations.resume_conditions: Provide token and invoke npx ovsx publish
